Hannah — quick legal take after an initial review and a short call with David Lane (outside counsel):

- Recommendation: Use the EU Commission 2021 SCCs, Module 2 (Controller -> Processor). That aligns with Galenix's stated role as controller and Redwood as processor.
- UK transfers: apply the UK addendum to the SCCs (the UK has a largely parallel regime; addendum + local review recommended).
- Evidence pack: executed SCCs (PDF signed), the DPA (DPA v2026), SOC 2 type II summary (redacted), a location map of processing regions, and a one-page legal rationale (we will produce). For higher-risk datasets (health data), we should also offer to share a redacted DPIA executive summary if the customer requests.
- Caveats: need written confirmation of Galenix's role (controller) and a list of the categories of special category data we will process. Also confirm whether there will be any subcontractors or onward transfers — that affects the scope of Module 2 and potential need for Flow-through annexes.

I've attached a draft opinion and a Module 2 template for review. I propose we ask procurement for a short signature window and offer DocuSign for execution. Timeline: 5–8 business days if Galenix signs off on controller status and the data mapping.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Julia — thanks for the clear ask and apologies for the back-and-forth. Short answers below and next steps to get this across the finish line.

Recommendation
- Redwood recommends the EU Commission 2021 SCCs, Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) for EU-origin data where Galenix is the controller and Redwood is the processor. For UK data, we will apply the standard UK addendum alongside the SCCs.

What we'll provide (attachments sent)
- Executable SCCs template (redwood-sccs-module2-template.docx) — ready for DocuSign.
- One-page legal rationale from our counsel summarizing the legal basis and residual risk (legal-opinion-sccs-20261130.pdf).
- DPA v2026 (dpa-summary-2026.pdf) and a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary on request.

Timeline and required inputs
- Target: 7–10 business days from confirmation of the following by your team: (1) confirmation that Galenix is the Controller; (2) a brief data mapping (categories of personal data and any special categories); (3) confirmation of any expected subcontractors / onward transfers.
- We will route the SCCs template through DocuSign once we have the confirmation. DocuSign link will be shared in a follow-up (we have a template ready: https://app.docusign.com/templates/ABC123).

Next steps for Galenix
1) Reply to confirm Controller status and supply the data categories and any subprocessors.
2) Let us know if you need a redacted DPIA executive summary — we can provide one for health-related datasets.

Cc'ing David Lane for any jurisdiction-specific comments (UK addendum / local counsel). Markus & Marissa — I appreciate the quick turnaround. Priyom, please queue the SOC 2 redaction checklist and confirm when the redacted summary is ready.
